summary: Verified both fixes from the review request. Backend: POST /api/admin/media no longer leaks MongoDB _id and returns clean JSON (200) with valid media_id; GET /api/admin/media items also strip _id; admin-only guard works. Frontend: MediaPicker component is integrated in MenuManager (Add Menu Item -> 'Choose from Library' + 'Upload' visible), MerchManager (Choose from Library present), and BlogManager (Choose from Library present). Opening the picker shows all three tabs (Media Library, Upload New, Paste URL). The Media Library tab renders 6 existing images; clicking one selects it, closes the dialog, and fires an 'Image selected' toast. Admin login works with admin@nicnackables.com/NicNack2024!.

issues: React a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' - add DialogDescription to MediaPicker dialog for accessibility (non-blocking).

passed_tests: pytest backend/tests/test_media.py: 3/3 passed (GET list no _id, POST create no _id + persisted, unauth blocked)
Admin login flow works via UI
MenuManager -> Add Item shows MediaPicker (Choose from Library + Upload buttons)
MerchManager -> Add Product shows MediaPicker (Choose from Library present)
BlogManager -> Add Post shows MediaPicker (Choose from Library present)
MediaPicker dialog exposes three tabs: Media Library, Upload New, Paste URL
Selecting an image from library closes dialog and shows 'Image selected' toast
No 'failed' toast surfaced after selecting from library (previous bug fixed)
action_items: Optional a11y fix: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to MediaPicker's DialogContent to silence Radix warning.
Optional: expose a hidden file input on MediaManager list page so automated tests can upload without opening the modal (currently upload is only reachable via 'Upload Images' modal).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend fix at server.py:1815 (media_dict.pop('_id', None)) is correct and unit-tested. Consider using db.media_library.insert_one(media_dict) with a projection or explicit dict construction to avoid mutation-after-insert surprises in future edits.
MediaPicker.jsx also POSTs to /api/admin/media after /api/upload; because the backend now returns a clean dict, that flow will no longer trip the axios error handler for the serialization bug.
MediaPicker: data-testid is derived from label (e.g. 'media-picker-image') - good, but consider a stable prop-based testid to avoid collisions when multiple pickers with same label exist on one page.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ media item was created and then deleted during pytest (cleanup handled in test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Media serialization fix and MediaPicker integration are verified end-to-end. If revisiting, note that MediaManager's own upload uses a modal-triggered file input (not exposed on the list page), so UI upload tests need to click 'Upload Images' first to reveal the input.
rca_of_the_issue: Original 'failed' toast on media upload was caused by POST /api/admin/media returning the just-inserted dict which still contained MongoDB's ObjectId _id (added by pymongo.insert_one), making FastAPI's JSON encoding fail on the response despite the DB write succeeding. Fix: pop '_id' from the dict before returning. Verified: response is now clean JSON without _id and axios no longer treats the response as failed.
